# Defeature
中文 | English

Local STEP defeaturing with Siemens NX, Python/OCC and a DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
CAD workbench. Geome
try results are proposed as Candidates for user review.
## What It Does

- Inspect STEP geometry in a browser, select faces and review fillet components.
- Use NX to attempt

fillet removal and inspect the resulting Candidate before
accepting or rejecting it.
- Run a persis

tent NX worker to avoid restarting NX for each supported operation.
- Use the DSH plugin's CAD tools
and skills, or run the standalone Web application.

The production agent exposes a restricted CAD tool set. The explicitly enabled
development preset in

cludes shell, source editing and arbitrary NXOpen execution;
it is not a sandbox for untrusted promp

ts or files. If rollback cannot be verified,
the worker is quarantined and Candidate publication is

les. If rollback cannot be verified,
the worker is quarantined and Candidate publication is blocked.
## Requirements

- Windows x64, Siemens NX and a valid NX license for NX operations; NX2406 has
been used during deve

lopment.
- Node.js 22.19 or later and DSH Web for the plugin; the plugin guide lists the
tested DSH

version.
- A compatible Python environment with Python/OCC and backend dependencies.
The plugin can
offer an isolated environment installation after confirmation.

NX, proprietary SDK files and license credentials are not included. This project
does not claim comp
atibility with every NX or DSH version.

- Independent Web application: setup guide.

nt NX runtime: protocol.
- Controlled CAD tools: contracts.

## Local Configuration

Set NX paths through the workbench or `UGII_BASE_DIR`, `NX_RUN_JOURNAL` and
`NX_STEP214_EXPORT_DEF`.

Set `DEFEATURE_PYTHON` to select a Python interpreter.
The independent Web application only reads O

penCode provider configuration when
